business_summary: Wonderful Sky Financial Group Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides financial public relations and international roadshow services in Hong Kong, the People's Republic of China, and Singapore. It offers financial public relations services, including corporate positioning, media relations management, press release and speech composing, IPO advertising plan, design and production of corporate marketing brochures, and events coordination services. The company also provides investor relations services, such as daily stock price monitoring, investor database creation and maintenance, research report collection and analysis, stock price fluctuation report, and intelligent investor relations management system. In addition, it offers project management, logistical arrangements, roadshow desk support, and online roadshow services; and financial printing services comprising IPO prospectus, financial reports, corporate announcements, corporate brochures and marketing collaterals, compliance documentations, and corporate presentation materials, as well as translation, copywriting, editing, and typesetting services. Further, the company provides corporate branding services, including outdoor and LED neon billboard, public transportation promotion, print media and TV promotion, digital platform promotion, and pop-up ads/banners on mobile application, as well as 3D displays and mobile showrooms; ESG report services; IPO investment services, such as enterprise strategic investment advisory, facilitation of strategic collaboration between enterprises, and entrepreneurial growth strategy consultation; and employee group and individual high-end medical, directors and officers liability, and international roadshow officers life insurance products. Additionally, it invests in properties and securities; and holds properties and yachts. Wonderful Sky Financial Group Holdings Limited was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Central, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Wonderful Sky Financial Group Holdings Limited는 홍콩, 중국 및 싱가포르에서 금융 홍보 및 국제 로드쇼 서비스를 제공합니다. 기업 포지셔닝, 미디어 관계 관리, 보도 자료 및 연설문 작성, IPO 광고 계획, 기업 마케팅 브로셔 디자인 및 제작, 이벤트 조정 서비스 등 금융 홍보 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 일일 주가 모니터링, 투자자 데이터베이스 생성 및 유지 관리, 연구 보고서 수집 및 분석, 주가 변동 보고서, 지능형 투자자 관계 관리 시스템 등 투자자 관계 서비스도 제공합니다. 또한 프로젝트 관리, 물류 준비, 로드쇼 데스크 지원 및 온라인 로드쇼 서비스를 제공합니다. IPO 투자 설명서, 재무 보고서, 기업 공지 사항, 기업 브로셔 및 마케팅 자료, 규정 준수 문서, 기업 프리젠테이션 자료는 물론 번역, 카피라이팅, 편집 및 조판 서비스로 구성된 금융 인쇄 서비스도 포함됩니다. 또한, 회사는 기업 브랜딩 서비스를 제공합니다.
